column1: # Arabic business-name words (curated 2026-11-10). A name is a trade name (often an Arabic noun

# مؤسسة النور للتجارة, شركة العتيبي للمقاولات. Words carry the Latin form these firms use
# themselves (Al Noor Trading, Al Otaibi Contracting) after "=", used for domains. Coined names are
# not an Arabic pattern; a coined pattern falls back to {adjective}. A section key serves every
# division of the section that has no row of its own. Columns as in en.tsv.
